canonical_json.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM and without a trailing line feed for identity preimages
canonical_json.objects: reject duplicate keys; emit keys in ascending Unicode scalar-value order; no insignificant whitespace
canonical_json.arrays: preserve the semantic order declared by the projection; never sort observations, parameters or segments after projection
canonical_json.strings: NFC-normalize only fields explicitly marked result-bearing metadata; logical row_id is never an identity preimage except inside already-hashed ledgers
canonical_json.integers: canonical base-10 JSON integer with no leading zero and no negative zero
canonical_json.binary64: normalize -0 to +0 and replace every finite value by JSON string f64:<16 lowercase hexadecimal digits of big-endian IEEE-754 bytes>; reject NaN and infinity
canonical_json.hash: lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact canonical preimage bytes

model_structure_projection.source: the validated model-v1 artifact; unknown/missing projection source fields fail
model_structure_projection.segment_order: artifact order: single, or left then right

model_instance_projection.source: the same validated model-v1 artifact; construct the structure projection, then replace each segment by the exact numeric segment projection and p2 by the exact numeric p2 projection
model_instance_projection.parameters: copy the artifact parameter object with exact keys; canonical JSON sorts keys and converts every finite value to tagged binary64; an allowed constant branch may be an empty object

openai_compatible_base_url.parse: parse the complete Unicode input as one absolute hierarchical URL; leading/trailing ASCII whitespace, control characters and backslash are rejected before parsing
openai_compatible_base_url.scheme: ASCII-lowercase; https is required except explicit insecure opt-in; http without opt-in is accepted only for a loopback host
openai_compatible_base_url.userinfo_query_fragment: username, password, query and fragment are forbidden, including empty marker forms ending in ? or #
openai_compatible_base_url.host: required; Unicode/non-ASCII and percent-encoding are rejected; a DNS name must already be an ASCII A-label, is lowercased, has one terminal dot removed and each label must match LDH with no leading/trailing hyphen; IPv4 is canonical dotted decimal; IPv6 is RFC 5952 lowercase compressed inside brackets
openai_compatible_base_url.port: decimal 1..65535; omit explicit 443 for https and 80 for http; preserve any other port without leading zero
openai_compatible_base_url.path: empty or / becomes empty origin path; otherwise slash-separated nonempty ASCII segments matching [A-Za-z0-9._~-]+; percent-encoding, duplicate slash and dot/dot-dot segments are rejected; one terminal slash is removed
openai_compatible_base_url.normalized_origin: scheme://canonical-host plus non-default port, with IPv6 brackets and no path
openai_compatible_base_url.loopback: only canonical DNS host localhost or an IPv4/IPv6 address classified loopback; subdomains of localhost are not loopback
openai_compatible_base_url.redirects: HTTP redirect following is disabled; any 3xx is a typed advisor transport failure
openai_compatible_base_url.persistence: persist only SHA-256 of normalized_origin and normalized_endpoint; never persist raw URL or access token

anti_alias_checks: Changing any included analysis field changes analysis_id.
Changing only an analysis exclusion leaves analysis_id unchanged.
Changing a parameter tagged binary64 changes model_instance_hash but not model_structure_hash.
Changing family, direction, segment order or join/membership semantics changes model_structure_hash.
Negative zero and positive zero have one canonical tagged representation.
A duplicate JSON key, unknown projection field, non-finite number or untagged binary64 fails before hashing.
Different normalized endpoint paths may share an origin hash but must have different normalized_endpoint_sha256 and analysis_id.
